findings.issue: The feature describes EMI conversion on credit card purchases, which is explicitly prohibited under [DLD2025:20(i)] as RE shall not enter into DLG arrangements for revolving credit facilities offered through digital lending channel and credit cards as defined under Master Direction – Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022 dated April 21, 2022.

findings.fix: Remove or disable the EMI conversion feature for credit card purchases as it is explicitly prohibited under DLD2025:20(i). Ensure that the feature is not available in any form within the app or on the website.
findings.verifier_note: The RBI paragraph explicitly prohibits RE from entering into DLG arrangements for revolving credit facilities offered through credit cards as defined under the Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card. Since EMI conversion is part of the credit card facility and falls under the prohibited DLG arrangements, the feature violates the restriction in [DLD2025:20(i)].

findings.issue: The feature states that 'The nodal grievance officer's name and contact are shown in the app and on the bank's website, along with a link to RBI's CMS portal.' However, the RBI paragraph [DLD2025:11(ii)] requires that contact details of the nodal grievance redressal officers shall be 'prominently displayed on the websites of the RE, its LSP and on the DLA, as well as in the KFS provided to the borrower.' The feature does not explicitly mention the KFS (Know Your Customer Form) or confirm that the details are prominently displayed in the KFS, which is a requirement under the paragraph.

summary: The compliance review of the CardFlex: EMI Conversion for Credit Card Purchases feature identified two key findings against the reviewed RBI rules. First, the feature allows EMI conversion on credit card purchases, which is explicitly prohibited under DLD2025:20(i).
